integrity: Symbolic and exact-rational reproducibility checks supplied as standalone code; finite enumeration is not an infinite proof. All continuous claims require the included analytic proof. Older equivalent random-switching formulae remain a literature risk.
scientific_limitations: Scalar strictly convex quadratic, iid Bernoulli delay zero/one, constant positive step and no additive noise. Exact mean-square boundary and one specified pathwise/mean-square witness only; not a statement about general delayed or high-dimensional stochastic optimization.
title: Sharp Bernoulli stale-gradient stability and a pathwise-versus-mean-square split
